content: Avengers: Doomsday is a month away and will find the Avengers, the New Avengers, and X-Men from the Fox films facing off against Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom. Originally, the fifth Avengers film was titled The Kang Dynasty and would have starred Jonathan Majors as Kang, who appeared in Loki and Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania. Marvel fired him in December 2023 after he was convicted on assault and harassment charges, and retooled The Kang Dynasty into the Doctor Doom-centric Doomsday.
